steps.what: Compare products to the specifications at the bench.
Decide to reject products that miss those specifications.
Discard the rejected products into the reject bin.
Record the reject reason on the production order.
Post that reject reason onto the defect tally.

tasks.design: She still compares the product with the specification, decides the reject, and discards it by hand. {OPS_SYSTEM}, the manufacturing execution record, keeps the reject reason she enters, and posts that same reason onto the {SPREADSHEET} tally. No camera makes the reject decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: The reject reason was already on the order, then copied onto a tally.
tasks.enabler_now: The tally can be posted from the reason code she already stored.
tasks.still_hard: Seeing whether the product misses the specification.
tasks.human_edge: She sees the product and decides that it is a reject.
tasks.altitude: She still compares, decides and discards. The tally repeats the reason she entered. She does not gain a right to change the specification.

reach.task: Release a rejected lot only after reading the reject reason
reach.learn: Read the reason she recorded. A missing reason means the tally was not posted.

evidence.claim: A rejected part is often marked on the order and the same reason is written again on a tally.
AI is high-risk as a safety component of a product under annex I law, including machinery, and sorting good from bad parts is not a safety function.
Safety components and embedded systems with self-evolving machine-learning behaviour that ensure safety functions need third-party conformity assessment.
Consent is required for systems that can monitor staff presence, behaviour or performance, and per-operator logs and line cameras qualify.
A data-protection impact assessment is required where cameras capture staff.

assumptions: The specification card has characteristic, low, high and unit. The producer is the quality engineer who owns the specification, stored on the order before this task. It is not saved here. If no card is stored, she compares against the paper specification in s1, which stays at full time.

The reject record fields are order id, part id, reason code and quantity. She types them in s4, and that capture stays at full time. s5 only posts those stored fields into the tally row. If the reason code is blank, s5 does not run and she updates the tally by hand.

Comparing, deciding and discarding stay at full time. No camera and no learning model makes the reject. The record stores the order and the reason, not a score of the inspector. Dutch works-council consent applies where the site is in the Netherlands; elsewhere, national rules.
The 0.3 hours are the occasional new reason code that needs a tally column. Vendor trial percentages are not this task's saving.
unknowns: Whether this line still keeps a separate defect tally beside the production order.
Whether reject reasons are already a fixed code list.
research_questions: What share of reject reasons on this line is written both on the order and on a tally?

incremental.description: Add a tally column when a new reject reason has no column yet.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only the second writing of a reject reason she has already stored is posted to the tally. Comparing, deciding, discarding and entering the reason stay at full time. A week with no separate tally, or with blank reason codes, saves nothing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Notice the production problem on the line.
Decide which supervisors or personnel must be told.
Notify those supervisors of the production problem.
Write the production problem on the line record.
Send that written problem to the named supervisors.

tasks.design: She still notices the problem, chooses the supervisor, tells them, and writes the note. {CHAT} sends that note from {OPS_SYSTEM} to the person she named. The conversation stays hers, and nothing is sent when the note is blank.
tasks.previous_blocker: The problem was already told and written, then typed again into a message.
tasks.enabler_now: The message can be sent from the note she already wrote.
tasks.still_hard: Judging which problem is worth stopping someone for.
tasks.human_edge: She was on the line and knows which supervisor needs to hear it.
tasks.altitude: She still notices, chooses who to tell, and has the conversation. The message is the note she wrote. She does not hand the judgement to a queue.

reach.task: Act on the production problem she already stated
reach.learn: Use the note she wrote. A problem with no note is still the conversation she had.

evidence.claim: A production problem is often told in person and then typed again into a message.
Consent is required for systems that can monitor staff presence, behaviour or performance, and per-operator logs and line cameras qualify.

assumptions: The problem note fields are order id, station, problem text, recipient id and time. She writes them in s4, and that capture stays at full time. s5 sends that stored text to that recipient. If the problem text or the recipient id is blank, s5 does not run and she sends the message by hand.
Noticing, choosing the person and telling them stay at full time. The send does not decide that there is a problem.
The note names the order and the problem, not a score of the inspector. Dutch works-council consent applies where the site is in the Netherlands; elsewhere, national rules.
The 0.4 hours are the messages she still types when the note has no recipient id. No vendor percentage is this task's saving.
unknowns: Whether supervisors already read the line record, so the extra message is unused.
Whether the recipient can be selected as a person id rather than a free-text name.
research_questions: What share of production problems is both said to the supervisor and retyped into chat?

incremental.description: Type the message by hand when the note has no recipient id.

approvals.approved_version: The problem note she just wrote, with the order id, the station, the problem text and the recipient she selected. A blank problem text is not sent. A later edit to the note voids this binding.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only the retyped chat of a problem she has already written is sent from that note. Noticing, choosing who to tell, the conversation and writing the note stay at full time. A problem she only speaks, or a note with no recipient, saves nothing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write inspection reports of results and repairs.

steps.what: Review the product beside the test results.
Read the stored test results for that order.
Decide the recommendations and needed repairs.
Write those recommendations on the inspection note.
Draft inspection reports from the results and repairs.

loop.input: The stored test results and the inspection note. No photo of the inspector, and no repair she did not write.
loop.output: One inspection report of those results and those repairs.
loop.check: Every result in the report is a value in the stored test results, and every repair is written in the inspection note. It adds no result, limit or repair she did not write.
loop.stop: One pass. If the sentence fails the check, or the inspection note is blank, or no stored results exist, the draft stays blank and she writes the report.
loop.why_not_simpler: The repairs are free text. A fixed template can place the numbers but cannot phrase the repair she wrote, and a rule cannot tell a supported sentence from a line the note does not state.

steps.what: Check the inspection report cites those results.
File the confirmed inspection report on the record.

tasks.design: She still looks at the product, reads the stored results, decides the repairs, and writes them. {OPS_SYSTEM} drafts the inspection report from those results and that note, and stays blank if a sentence adds a result or a repair she did not write. She checks the report before it is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The report was typed again from readings and a repair note already written.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded loop can phrase the report from those readings and that note.
tasks.still_hard: Judging which repair the result actually needs.
tasks.human_edge: She saw the product and chose the repair.
tasks.altitude: She still looks, decides and writes the repair. The filed report is the one she checked. She does not gain a right to change a limit.

reach.task: Read the confirmed inspection report before changing the process
reach.learn: Read the confirmed report, not the draft. A blank draft means she has not filed that report.

evidence.claim: An inspection report often restates readings and repair notes already written.
Q-DAS O-QIS reads gauges, CMMs and PLCs for statistical process control, with control charts, alarms and a link to SAP QM.
Consent is required for systems that can monitor staff presence, behaviour or performance, and per-operator logs and line cameras qualify.

assumptions: The test-result card has order id, characteristic, measured value, unit, limit and time. The producer is the earlier measurement entry on {OPS_SYSTEM}, or the gauge when it already writes that card. That capture sits outside this task and is not saved here. If no card is stored, the draft stays blank and she writes the report from the paper sheet.

The inspection note is her repair text, written in s4 at full time, before the draft. The loop adds no result, limit or repair that note and those readings do not state. A blank draft is not filed. A later change to the note or the readings voids the confirmed report.

Looking, reading, deciding, writing the note and checking the report stay at full time. The filing step only stores the sentence she confirmed. The published gauge link is not this task's saving. The report names the order and the result, not a score of the inspector.
The 0.8 hours are a monthly sample of filed reports for a result or a repair the note does not state. The 6 hours of checking sit inside s6 and are not deducted again.
unknowns: Whether test readings on this line are stored against the order or only on a paper sheet.
Whether the inspection report is free text or a fixed form of a few fields.
research_questions: What share of inspection reports on this line restates readings and a repair note written the same shift?

already_counted.description: Reading the draft against the stored results and the inspection note.

incremental.description: Monthly sample of filed reports for a result or a repair the note does not state.

approvals.approved_version: The inspection report she confirmed, stating only results present in the stored readings and repairs written in the inspection note. A blank draft is not filed. A later change to the note or the readings voids this binding.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only phrasing the formal report from readings and a repair note she has already written, and filing the sentence she confirmed, is shortened. Looking, reading, deciding, writing the note and checking stay at full time. A paper-only week, or a thin note that leaves the draft blank, saves almost nothing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Recommend corrective actions from inspection results.

steps.what: Read the inspection results for that order.
Recommend the necessary corrective actions from those results.
Tell the supervisor that corrective action in person.
Write that corrective action on the action note.
Draft the corrective action line from that note.

loop.input: The action note and the stored inspection results. No cause and no action she did not write.
loop.output: One corrective-action line citing her action and a stored result.
loop.check: The line states only a corrective action written in the action note and a result present in the inspection results. It adds no cause, limit or action she did not write.
loop.stop: One pass. If the line fails the check, or the action note is blank, or no stored results exist, the draft stays blank and she writes the line.
loop.why_not_simpler: The action is free text. A code list cannot state the repair she wrote, and a template cannot tell her sentence from an action the note does not contain.

steps.what: Check the action line cites her corrective action.
File the confirmed corrective action on the record.

tasks.design: She still reads the results, recommends the corrective action, and tells the supervisor. {OPS_SYSTEM} drafts one action line from the note she wrote and the stored results, and stays blank if the line adds an action she did not write. She checks the line before it is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The corrective action was decided and noted, then written again on a form.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded loop can phrase one action line from the note she already wrote.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing the corrective action when the results are thin.
tasks.human_edge: She knows which action fits this product and this line.
tasks.altitude: She still recommends and tells the supervisor. The filed line is the action she checked. She does not change a machine stop or a guard.

reach.task: Change the process only from the confirmed corrective action
reach.learn: Read the action she confirmed. A blank draft means she has not filed that action.

evidence.claim: A corrective action is decided by the inspector and often written again on a form.
Q-DAS O-QIS reads gauges, CMMs and PLCs into control charts and alarms for analysing test data.
Safety components and embedded systems with self-evolving machine-learning behaviour that ensure safety functions need third-party conformity assessment.

assumptions: The inspection-result card has order id, characteristic, measured value, unit and limit. The producer is the inspection record already stored on {OPS_SYSTEM}, another task. It is not saved here. If no card is stored, the draft stays blank and she writes the line from the part in front of her.

She writes the corrective action in s4 at full time, before the draft. The loop does not invent a cause or an action. A blank draft is not filed. A later edit to the action note voids the binding. If the action already sits only in that note, the form line is the second writing; it is not a second copy of a report filed in another task.

Reading, recommending, telling the supervisor, writing the note and checking the line stay at full time. The filed line does not change a guard or a stop. The chart product does not choose the action, and its existence is not this task's saving.
The 0.6 hours are a monthly sample of filed lines for an action the note does not state. The 4 hours of checking sit inside s6 and are not deducted again.
unknowns: Whether this line already files the corrective action inside the inspection report, so a second line adds nothing.
Whether she may file an action without the supervisor's signature.
research_questions: What share of corrective actions on this line is written twice, once in a note and again on a form?

already_counted.description: Reading the draft against the action note and the inspection results.

incremental.description: Monthly sample of filed action lines for an action the note does not state.

approvals.approved_version: The action line she confirmed, stating only a corrective action written in the action note and a result present in the inspection results. A blank draft is not filed. A later edit to the action note voids this binding.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only phrasing the form line from an action she has already written, and filing the sentence she confirmed, is shortened. Reading, recommending, telling the supervisor, writing the note and checking stay at full time. A week with no stored results, or a note she does not write, saves nothing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: She still compares the part, rejects it by hand, tells the supervisor, and decides the corrective action. Confirmed reports and action lines keep her check. She does not hand a reject decision to a camera or a model.
reach: The production supervisor reads the confirmed problem note and the corrective action before changing the process.
The quality engineer's specification stays the limit for a reject. A missing limit leaves the comparison on the paper specification.
skills_to_grow: Enter the reject reason once, and do not recopy it onto a tally.
Leave a report sentence blank when the inspection note does not state it.
Write the corrective action herself before any line is filed.
role.ambitious_version: Each rejected part, each problem she has already written, and each action she has decided has one confirmed record. She still compares, discards, notifies and recommends. Nothing is filed that she did not write or check.

job.title: Inspectors, Testers, Sorters, Samplers, and Weighers
